name: quick-finder-monorepo
description: Quick Finder - Production-Grade Lost & Found Management Platform

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const src='packages/shared';const dest='apps/api/node_modules/@quickfinder/shared';fs.mkdirSync(dest+'/src',{recursive:true});['package.json'].forEach(f=>fs.copyFileSync(src+'/'+f,dest+'/'+f));['constants.js','formatters.js','index.js','validators.js'].forEach(f=>fs.copyFileSync(src+'/src/'+f,dest+'/src/'+f));console.log('Copied @quickfinder/shared to api node_modules');" && npm run build --prefix apps/web

author: Quick Finder Team
